The two-day Halloween-weekend pop-up will show the brand's expanding collections, and attendees can shop in person.

WOODS by Jordyn 在 SoHo 举办品牌首个纽约线下零售快闪，适逢: WOODS by Jordyn hosts the brand's first New York in-person retail pop-up in SoHo, timed to Halloween weekend. Founded in 2023, the brand displays and sells its fashion, handbag, and footwear collections on site for shoppers to browse and buy.
